_comment: The onboarding decision tree, as data. Adapted from docs/onboarding/onboarding-tree.json per docs/onboarding/04-revisions.md, which is the final word: Q1's wording, the Situation block, and the two-panel cap all changed there. Copy is final and must appear on screen exactly as written. core/onboarding.ts is the only code that reads this file's shape. Node kinds: screen (no question, one button), question (one tap on an option), profile (a question that writes an Answers field). A next value is either a node id, a landing id (looked up in landings.json — any id absent from `nodes` is a landing), or {if, then, else} keyed on an Answers field already set. showIf hides an option unless the named field already equals the given value. optionsFrom: drawings means the options are the drawing set for that field, rendered as drawings rather than words.

S0.text:
This is you in fifteen years.
Everything starts in the middle. It moves with what you do, both ways.

Q1.text: What do you most want to work on?

options.label: Body
options.sub: How you look. How you feel in it.

options.label: Head
options.sub: Calm, focus, doing what you said you'd do.

options.label: People
options.sub: Friends. Who you call, who calls you.

options.label: Partner
options.sub: Someone to come home to. Or the one already there.

options.label: Money
options.sub: What's in the account, and where it goes.

options.label: None of them. I'm here to keep it that way.

Q1._note: On a repeat visit (from QMORE) every panel already chosen is removed, and the 'none' row is never shown — it is only ever the first option offered.

options.label: I've let myself go. Hair, skin, clothes.
I eat too much of the wrong things.
I say I'll do things and don't.

Q3Ha.text: Where does the time go instead?

options.label: I've lost touch with people I like.
There aren't many people to lose touch with.
I have people. I never see them.

Q3Pa.text: Is there anything you go to every week? A club, a class, a game, a team.

Q3Pb.text: Could you have four people over next month, without cooking?

options.label: We're good. I want to keep it that way.
We don't talk about anything that matters.
I meet people. It goes nowhere.
I'm not ready. I'd sort myself out first.
I don't know where it goes.
It's fine. I want it to grow.

QMORE.text: Is there anything else you want to work on?
QMORE._note: Shown after every landing except Z (Q1 answered 'none') and except once all five panels are chosen — both go straight to FIG_gender instead of this node, which core/onboarding.ts decides rather than a static next.

FIG_hair._note: The drawing set must include a 'none' option because H033 requires hair.

LAND.text:
Fifteen years out. Everything in the middle.
{countLine}
LAND._note: {n} counts the seeded habits across every landing reached this run that are tickable today (daily cadence). If none are daily, the line is 'Nothing due today.' and the weekly seeds are listed under it. Shows the personalised figure, all five panels at step 2, the seeded habits switched on, the offers switched off with a one-tap add. No tour, no tips, no next button — this is the app's main screen.
